description: All bytes are 0x-hex, lower case; uint values are JSON numbers. Generated by clients/clientkeys/scripts/pqchat-vectors.mjs (src/pqchat.js); never edit by hand. Random inputs are fixed: rnd(name, n) = the first n bytes of keccak256("scaas/pqchat/vectors/<name>/0") ‖ keccak256("scaas/pqchat/vectors/<name>/1") ‖ …; the labels are in the generator. PqChat TreeKEM secrets (frozen after T1b: a record or derivation change restarts every vector). Source: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-23-pqchat-treekem.md §5 (path secrets, ps[0] over pathContext, the path ciphertext, the schedule without init, K, the tree wrap, the info and the marker) and §10 (replay), plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-23-pqchat-treekem.md T1b; by src/treekem.js, the worlds of scripts/treekem-fixture.mjs. H(ikm, info, n) = HKDF-SHA-256(ikm, salt empty, info, n); labels are scaas/pqchat/v1/tree/<name>. people: UAs (mldsa65, pqKeygen of rnd(tree-secrets/mldsa65-bip39-seed, 64), account 0, index; A … H named in the order of their UAs, so every session's members are strictly sorted by (ua, keyId)) and their public keys; devices: a person's KEM version keyId (A2 = A's version 2), kemSeed = HKDF-Expand(HKDF-Extract("scaas.ua.kem.v1", rnd(tree-secrets/kem/<person>, 64)), "scaas.kem.1" ‖ ua ‖ be64 keyId, 96). secrets: per commit of the main world its pathContext, ps[0] = H(kemSeed, …/commit ‖ pathContext), ps[0..m] and the node key hashes. pathCt: inputs and outputs of each path ciphertext of the first two commits. schedule: ctx, S, K from the joiner and the context fields. scenarios: each world's genesis, steps (a commit with every piece and its signature, or a landed treeLeave / treeRemove kept under the head), rosters per epoch, the pin of every epoch, and each device's replay: per epoch of its secret range [epoch, state, reason], K, [info, inForce, flagged], the compromise warnings, the reads in order and the pin of the head (C25, C26: the forward walk from the cold tree; an exit's views without treeId). signers: every signer's registry record (kind, keyData), the keyless admins M (msig 2-of-2) and W (WebAuthn) included (F-3); a signature is hex (a single key) or {signature, members} (an msig's abi.encode(MemberSig[])). lies: an endpoint's views replaced by read name, the device and its pin, and what replay and prepare give (null: accepted; plan T11). UNAUDITED.
